claims.statement: Tom Allen intimated to his friends that he would not accept McCoole's last challenge to fight for the belts, saying he could not afford a month or two of training for a fight with no money to win.

claims.statement: Rumours from New York of a $1,000-a-side match between Tom Allen and Joe Goss of England, said to have been made by Joe Coburn and Jim Mace, were treated as moonshine; Allen said no match had been made and he had no information on the subject.
